name: Saiminjutsu Tsukatte Toilet de Itazura
original_name: 催眠術使ってトイレでいたずら
source:
I use hypnosis on a book-loving girl in the park I befriended,
then take her to the park washroom for some lewd teasing.

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE290194.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
我对在公园里结识的一名爱读书的女孩施以催眠，
随后把她带到公园的厕所里，进行淫猥的戏弄。

[摘自[url=https://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE290194.html]DLsite英文版[/url]]
